reviews.text: We had Epic do a beautiful travertine pavers pattern on our pool deck 5 years ago.  Pool leaked and needed several stones leveled in a few places. They did so much more work than I dreamed they would. It looks good as new!! Never had a contractor do MORE than expected! Can't recommend Jose @ Epic enough!!
reviews.author: Velda Little

reviews.text: We love Epic Pavers!  From start to finish they were so precise with their measuring. Every tile is perfection. We  have never had an issue with rainwater puddling anywhere.   Their work is clean perfection!  We highly recommend Luis and his crew.
reviews.author: Elizabeth Loukas

reviews.text: We love Epic Pavers! Luis and his crew are hardworking, friendly, clean up after themselves and the work they do is the best! He is very responsive when you call and they do everything they can to please the customer. The prices are competitive and they stand by their work. We would not use anyone else!
reviews.author: Jaimi Harrison

reviews.text: The worst customer service I have ever received as a builder.  They cancelled on me the evening before a job and pushed it out 4-6 weeks.  No call from Leo or Uriel, as a matter of fact,  they ignored me all day.  I would. It recommend this company due to the terrible communication and poor customer service.
reviews.author: Taelor Brewer

reviews.text: Jose with Epic Pavers showed up on time and provided me with a very competitive quote for paver walkway, pavestone repairs and a solution for better drainage on my driveway apron.  I have not yet made a decision, but I was very impressed with his knowledge of pavers and one of my neighbors has recently hired Jose and Epic Pavers for their driveway and the customer after almost a year is very satisfied and speaks highly of Jose's engagement with the project from start to finish.
reviews.author: Bill Abitz

reviews.text: This company is fabulous!  They built a 100 foot long, at points 6 foot high, retaining wall in my backyard (henceforth known as The Taj Ma Wall).  The work was so good I had them come back and install paved paths.  Tomas, the supervisor, is simply the best, at one point offering to remove three levels of block to replace a corner block that had a chipped edge.  I would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Mary Ann Jenkins

reviews.text: We would have considered hiring them but based on the duration of time it takes them to complete work and, keeping tidy work area and consideration of others around that will not happen.  Their crew is very inconsiderate to residents around work sites. For multiple days over the past 5-6 months they blocked alley and driveways of neighbors with vehicles, equipment, piles of dirt, rock and sand. They could have parked on the street or used the home owners driveway but just to make it convenient for them the rest of us are inconvenienced.
reviews.author: Renee Paylor

reviews.text: Epic Pavers completed the travertine decking for our pool builder. Sandblasted Crema Paloma travertine pavers turned out awesome for our design! The texture on the pavers help make a non-slip surface. The crew was professional and helpful for questions.
reviews.author: Anish Jose
